RYM Top — Scenes & Movements — English Underground

podcast.body: This album is noted as the first rock album to entirely utilize a drum machine for its percussive elements. This was a pioneering step in the integration of electronic rhythm devices into rock music. "the first rock bands used a drum machine for an entire album was a group called Kingdom Come, 1972."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
